We will spread the cow manure we collected during the dry season on this plot, and my father will try to buy one small bag of subsidized NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer if the stock reaches our village. We plant the millet seeds we kept from last year’s harvest, mixing them with cowpea in the same rows as my grandfather taught us, because the improved seeds in the market are too expensive. Our family will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves since we have no money to pay laborers, and we depend only on the rains because there is no irrigation water here.
